SELECT r.RegistrationID as id, r.AthleteID as athleteId, a.Name as athleteName, r.EventID as eventId, e.EventName as eventName, r.ItemID as itemId, p.ItemName as itemName, r.RegistrationTime as registrationTime, r.RegistrationStatus as registrationStatus FROM Registration r LEFT JOIN Athlete a ON r.AthleteID = a.AthleteID LEFT JOIN Event e ON r.EventID = e.EventID LEFT JOIN Eventitem p ON r.ItemID = p.ItemID
AND r.RegistrationStatus = #{status}
AND DATE(r.RegistrationTime) = DATE(#{date})
AND r.AthleteID = #{athleteId}
AND p.ItemName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND a.Name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY r.RegistrationTime DESC
